explication: ComfyUI Prompt Assistant is a custom-node extension for prompt editing, translation, image/video captioning, and related workflow utilities. The main user journey is to interact with an assistant or node in ComfyUI, submit text or media for processing, and receive generated or translated content in the workflow. The README documents additional UI features including tags, history, Markdown and node-document translation. Connections below rely on sampled excerpts, SOURCE INDEX references, and README statements; unsampled subsystem internals are represented conservatively.
